_comment: Authoritative RCMP partition/object allowlist for codeplug writes. Derived from Motorola CPS's own addressing in the capture sessions listed in 'sources' -- these are the partitions and object-id ranges CPS itself used. A codeplug write may target only partitions with writable=true; 0x82 (tuning/soft-pots) is a separate tuner session and is never writable. Regenerate with tools/derive_partition_map.py.

0x85.role: codeplug (unidentified region, read within the codeplug session)
